resource_texts.fact_41: If the party retrieves the magic sword buried with Sir Brandon in Brandon's Barrow Mound, they could slay the dragon whose scales nothing else has pierced. Father William says it is required, but George says no one knows if the legend is true or where the sword is.
resource_texts.fact_36: If Dunk helps Ingrid give her sleeping potion to Warwick tonight, Warwick will sleep through Dunk's time inside the house where the mithril shirt is kept. The potion may be weakened by the heavily diluted faun wine and doubts about Ingrid's skill.

rules.last_session: standalone beats rated low importance are dropped by code before assessment; threads/standalone events retain medium-or-high impact AND lasting consequence; an otherwise unrepresented encounter may also qualify with medium-or-high historical value, regardless of enduring consequence; no scene or character quota; validated main-event anchors sorted by Ledger position
rules.want: supported end and completion significance; primary adventure, other adventure, then meaningful side; importance and stable ties, not actionability; serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: openings only; supported enabling action toward a shown want/debt; direct role; equivalent offers/plans use validated canonical fact references; assets stay in state/history
rules.unknown: open_ended investigative objective: revelation with all four dimensions medium/high, or grounded/inspectable adventure-objective question linked to a shown adventure want; ordinary gaps excluded
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps; no assets in open matters

last_session.change: Dunk spotted a magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and told the party he had a plan to get it to help against the dragon.
The Clurichen Naggeneen was revealed as the drinker raiding Quinn's ale and now hangs captive in a bag behind Quinn's bar, still offering gold or a secret for release.
Dunk learned Ingrid secretly watches Warwick sleep, struck a deal for her to brew a sleeping potion he would help deliver, fetched faun wine for it and handed her a heavily diluted batch.
Father William revealed the dragon can only be killed with the magic sword buried with Brandon in his Barrow Mound, and the party set out to retrieve it.
Father William marked the Barrow Mound and the witch's home on the party's map, and the party planned to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
Uriah promised Father William penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation in return for marking the map.

George revealed the dragon's lair lies at the foot of the northern mountains, that it will soon fly, that its poison and scales defeated his friends, and that the Reeve may not have the promised 1000 gold.
Trout recruited the halfling Squints as a junior member of his Halfling Corps with promised treasure share, then used him as expendable bait to rescue the giant's captive.
Dunk out-drank the fauns and traded a rabbit's foot for a flask of faun wine.
Ingrid told Uriah that hidden fairies are encroaching more often, alongside the dragon.
The party snatched a captive from a man-eating giant's stone cottage in the woods and outran the giant.
The party rescued Brother Dirk from the giant's stewpot; he wanted to go home, but Phidipaldi objected and Trout assigned him to report to Squints.
